# ghost/tic-tac-toe

Dooz (F-Droid) tic-tac-toe against the computer: new game, play a cell, play several, read the board and result. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/tic-tac-toe
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/tic-tac-toe new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/tic-tac-toe play_cell --device <serial> --param cell=<cell>
ghost skill run ghost/tic-tac-toe play_cells --device <serial> --param cells=<cells>
ghost skill run ghost/tic-tac-toe get_board --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `new_game`: Start a new tic-tac-toe game
- `play_cell`: Play the centre square in tic-tac-toe
- `play_cells`: Play tic-tac-toe: centre, then top left, then bottom right
- `get_board`: What does the tic-tac-toe board look like?
